description:
Use this tool to retrieve the current credit balance of the authenticated Blog2Social API account. Use it when the user asks about available credits or before an action that may consume credits, such as publishing or retrieving post insights.

It returns the current available credit balance. It does not provide individual post analytics, account usage statistics, or billing details. Publishing is not possible when the balance is zero.
name: credits.balance

balance.description: Current number of available Blog2Social credits.

title: Check available Blog2Social API credits
